digest.component_or_area: tickets store initialization and CI checkout
propositions: Full clone of tickets costs 1.04 GiB / 59s wall time; blob:none filter reduces to 68.7 MiB / 14.3s (~15x reduction) while preserving complete commit graph needed for merge-base and era-scoping
Fetch timeout in Claude Code environment silently falls through to orphan bootstrap, creating empty divergent store with all reads returning [] and writes on non-fastforwardable branch
Blobless clone is safe for rebar access patterns: verify-identity whole-store scan runs faster on partial clone (3.75s vs 3.98s) as it is pure tree-level diff with bodies read from working tree
Fail-open fallthrough to worktree add --orphan must be replaced with fail-closed non-zero exit when remote fetch fails
CI jobs reconcile-bridge.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml require merge.ours.driver=true in config before blob:none filter to prevent 18 MB JSON merge degradation
.bridge_state.bak-retarget occupies 33 MB in tree and should be deleted before epic reclaim
